prompt: Which reading should the leads use for Mold 12 this quarter?
promptZh: 領班應採用 12 號模具的哪筆本季讀數？

options.text: The reading from the Thursday trial.
options.whyZh: 實際試作的是借來的備品，不是 12 號。

options.text: The reading on the renewal sheet.
options.whyZh: 在回生產現場前量得，不是重整後再次投入生產的讀數。

options.text: No reading, because the trial used a borrowed spare.
options.zh: 不用填讀數，因為試作使用借來的備品。
options.whyZh: 借來的是星期四用的備品；12 號模具是自有，且星期二已投入生產。

options.text: The reading from its Tuesday run.
options.zh: 12 號模具星期二生產作業的讀數。
options.whyZh: 重整後沒有用 12 號再次生產，不能改採其他模具的試作讀數或重整時的讀數。

explanationZh: 重整後沒有用 12 號再次生產，不能改採其他模具的試作讀數或重整時的讀數。
evidence: For molds we do own, use the wear reading from the last production run wherever possible. / Mold 12 belongs to us. It ran on Tuesday and its surface was renewed on Wednesday. / The workshop reserved it for a Thursday trial but used a borrowed spare when the renewal took longer than expected.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: For molds we do own, use the wear reading from the last production run wherever possible.
Mold 12 belongs to us. It ran on Tuesday and its surface was renewed on Wednesday.
The workshop reserved it for a Thursday trial but used a borrowed spare when the renewal took longer than expected.

vocabulary.note: run 在製造語境可指一次實際開機生產，不等同預留時段。
